evals.name: fires-on-scripts-inventory
evals.prompt: Our scripts have gotten messy. Which of them do we still need?
evals.expected_output: The skill inventories the repository's scripts and task-runner entries, gives each one a keep, migrate, consolidate or retire verdict with its file evidence, and edits nothing.
expectations: The response gives every script and task-runner entry one of keep, migrate, consolidate or retire, with the file that supports it
The response makes no edit to any file and asks before any deletion

evals.name: stays-quiet-on-code-fix
evals.prompt: The slugify helper drops digits. Fix it and add a test.
evals.expected_output: The audit-tools skill does not run; the request is a code fix, not a tooling audit.
expectations: The response fixes the helper and adds a test
The response does not inventory the repository's scripts, hooks or tools
